items.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
items.preflight_note: Endpoint and adapter shape are confirmed, but the account has demonstrated paid usage.

quota.reset: monthly; exact date/account details may vary
quota.summary: Free users receive $0.10/month in inference credits; extra usage requires purchased credits. Request/token caps are not stated here.

items.name: Google AI Studio API
items.preflight_note: Endpoint and adapter shape are confirmed from primary documentation; account limits still require operator review.

quota.reset: RPD resets at midnight Pacific; other windows vary
quota.summary: Limits vary by model and project. Google exposes RPM, input TPM, and RPD; exact values must be read from AI Studio. The API key alone does not prove a free tier for a given model.

items.name: Cerebras API
items.preflight_note: Endpoint and adapter shape are confirmed; account tier is not treated as permanent free compute.

quota.reset: continuous token-bucket replenishment; hourly/daily free-trial caps apply
quota.summary: The free trial currently provides model-specific limits such as 5 RPM, 30K TPM, 1M TPH, and 1M TPD, but requires verified payment setup and $5 expiring credits. Cerebras documents no permanent free tier; do not treat this as free recurring compute.

items.name: Groq API
items.preflight_note: Endpoint and current catalog IDs are confirmed from primary documentation.

quota.reset: provider headers report the applicable reset; exact values vary by model/account
quota.summary: Groq publishes model-specific free-plan examples, but exact organization limits and the first exhausted dimension must be read from response headers/account settings. The catalog avoids model IDs already scheduled for deprecation.

items.name: Cohere API
items.preflight_note: Compatibility endpoint and current model IDs are confirmed; free eligibility remains account-dependent.

quota.summary: Cohere documents an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint. Cohere's Command A+ page says trial and production keys are free until rate limits are reached, while Command A publishes paid prices; verify the key's actual tier and headers before use.

items.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
items.preflight_note: Account ID and credential must be supplied and verified before model access can be checked.

quota.summary: Workers AI requires an account ID plus API token. Usage limits and included neurons depend on the Cloudflare account plan; local caps should be set conservatively until the dashboard values are confirmed.

items.name: OpenRouter Free Models
items.preflight_note: OpenAI-compatible endpoint is confirmed; free-model availability remains account-dependent.

quota.reset: daily; exact reset behavior should be confirmed from account headers
quota.summary: Free models are limited to 50 requests/day without purchased credits; OpenRouter documents 1,000/day after at least $10 in credits. No token cap is prefilled.

items.name: Z.AI GLM API
items.preflight_note: Endpoint and IDs are documented, but account-region access has not been verified.

items.name: TokenRouter
items.preflight_note: Official API docs use the .io host; the saved credential and routed-model access still need a no-generation verification.

quota.summary: TokenRouter's official API documentation describes a Responses API at the .io host and requires at least one upstream provider key. Rate limits vary by plan; keep this family quarantined until the saved key and routed access are verified.

items.name: NVIDIA NIM
items.preflight_note: Catalog IDs are documented as free endpoints, but key-specific model access has not been verified.

quota.summary: NVIDIA marks several hosted endpoints as free, but exact request/token limits and access depend on the NVIDIA API key and endpoint. The catalog uses model IDs currently shown as free endpoints in NVIDIA's model directory; verify access through the no-generation models endpoint before testing.

items.name: Mistral AI
items.preflight_note: Endpoint and current model IDs are confirmed; account free eligibility remains unverified.

quota.summary: Free mode is available without a card, but current limits are shown in the Mistral Admin Panel. Completion limits are per model and organization; model pages list current API IDs and paid prices, so do not assume a free tier.

items.name: SambaNova Cloud
items.preflight_note: Endpoint and selected model IDs are confirmed; operator has this family disabled.

quota.reset: provider response headers report the applicable reset
quota.summary: SambaNova's free tier applies when no payment method is linked. Current documented free limits for Meta-Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and gpt-oss-120b are 20 RPM, 20 RPD, and 200,000 TPD; response headers report remaining/reset values. Keep this family disabled until the operator confirms the account tier.

items.name: Aion Labs
items.preflight_note: Endpoint, model IDs, and documented model-list envelope are confirmed.

quota.reset: daily token limit; exact reset time is provider-defined
quota.summary: The default free tier documents 15 RPM, 20,000 tokens/minute, and 20,000 tokens/day. The API is OpenAI-compatible; no credit card is required for the free tier according to the provider pricing page. Roleplay/storytelling specialization is provider-described, not independently benchmarked.

items.name: Kilo Gateway
items.preflight_note: Anonymous free access is documented, but the current model catalog has not been checked.

quota.reset: IP-based anonymous limit is hourly; model/account limits vary
quota.summary: Kilo documents unauthenticated access for free models with a 200 requests/hour/IP limit. Free model availability can change; the catalog uses only free IDs named in Kilo's authentication documentation and must still be checked through the no-auth models endpoint.

items.name: Ollama Cloud
items.preflight_note: Cloud OpenAI-compatible endpoint is documented; account/model limits remain qualitative.

quota.reset: session limits reset every 5 hours; weekly limits reset every 7 days
quota.summary: Ollama's Free plan includes cloud-model access with light usage. Limits are not a fixed token number: usage depends on input, cached input, output, and model compute weight. The provider documents a 5-hour session window and 7-day weekly window; exact allowances are account/model dependent.

items.name: BazaarLink
items.preflight_note: Free routes and endpoint are documented, but current model availability has not been checked.

quota.reset: RPM is rolling; daily usage is unlimited subject to free quota/credits
quota.summary: BazaarLink documents a free tier of 10 RPM and 150 requests/day for accounts without credit, plus an auto:free route. Requests must use the full provider/model ID or the documented auto:free route; after free quota, paid fallback must be disabled to guarantee zero spend.

items.name: xAI Inference API
items.preflight_note: OpenAI-compatible endpoint is confirmed; account allowance remains unverified.
